description: Potentiel éolien - Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - 2019 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ids.craig.fr. In the context of the assessment of renewable energy potentials, the wind potential has been characterised for the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region. This potential covers the electricity generation systems of the “large wind turbine”, the “small wind turbine” not being addressed here. Note that the potential does not take into account existing facilities. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Wind potential - Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - 2019" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include éolien. The listing shows 2019-04-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
